Existing independent grants, pause overlay, policies and canonical calldata/value controls remain required; these methods require zero native value.

Exact Ethereum Sturdy V2 own Swell WETH aggregator, not Sturdy V1, an individual Swell protocol admission, or a Morpho curator alias. Published official address and full deployment-bound YearnV3Vault.vy source/ABI retained. Sourcify labels are creationMatch=match, runtimeMatch=null, not exact_match; Blockscout marks partially verified, not fully verified.

deposit pulls assets from msg.sender with preexisting WETH approval and issues receiver shares rounded down; mint pulls assets rounded up to issue exact shares. WETH quantities use 18-decimal base units, not native ETH. Receiver is explicit and must not be zero or this vault; depositing for another receiver does not grant caller ownership of their shares.

withdraw burns owner shares rounded up for requested assets and defaults max_loss to 0; redeem burns exact shares, values assets rounded down, and the three-argument overload defaults max_loss to 10000 basis points (100% loss tolerance). Four-argument overloads set an explicit loss ceiling in basis points capped at 10000; neither grants arbitrary execution.

For caller-owned exits set owner=caller; otherwise vault spends existing owner share allowance. Explicit nonzero receiver receives assets. Exits synchronously unwind default queue or caller-supplied registered-strategy queue; use_default_queue can override supplied queue. Each used strategy must have nonzero activation; maximum queue length ten. Ordering affects realized losses/liquidity; strategy/limit-module dependencies can revert. No asynchronous claim or guaranteed payout.

Scalar financial methods and custom registered-strategy queue exit overloads are selected. Queue addresses are validated registered strategies using fixed interfaces, not arbitrary target/calldata execution. Strategy registration/debt administration, reports, buy_debt, shutdown/roles, share approvals/transfers and permits remain excluded. Existing roles retain mutable strategy/module configuration.

Governance can change deposit/withdraw limit modules, accountant, strategy debt/queue and profit-unlocking settings. Locked profit affects share valuation and accountant report fees may dilute shares; no fixed current fee/rate/price promise. Point-in-time isShutdown=false and positive maxDeposit are eligibility observations only, not ongoing live status.

existingFunctionUpdates.label: OctoSwap add liquidity
warnings: Static deployment/source/ABI metadata only; no persistent runtime identity, funding, liquidity, execution, financial safety or complete-workflow assurance. Exact grants, independent policies, pauses and canonical calldata/value validation remain required.

Chain 143 is Monad mainnet. ETH-named functions use native MON; WETH() is immutable WMON 0x3bd359c1119da7da1d913d1c4d2b7c461115433a. addLiquidityETH, swapExactETHForTokens, swapETHForExactTokens and swapExactETHForTokensSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens accept native value; nonpayable methods require zero native value. Native surplus refund behavior is method-specific, not guaranteed by payable mutability.

This non-proxy Classic router binds immutable factory 0xce104732685b9d7b2f07a09d828f6b19786cda32 and pair init-code hash 0x1305842295bb388975eec146e164811bee4ac15606baa6205d5749e933f26762. Token path elements select factory-derived pairs, not arbitrary targets/selectors/bytes; router uses fixed pair.swap with empty callback bytes. Universal Router, multicall, CL router/position manager, permit, direct pair mint/burn, callbacks and admin capabilities are not admitted.

ERC20 input and both liquidity assets are pulled from msg.sender directly to the derived pair using prior router allowance; LP removal pulls caller LP shares to pair and burns them atomically. Recipient to is caller-selected and can differ from owner/caller. No delegated owner parameter or authorization is inferred. Never pre-fund pairs or router: pair mint/burn account for surplus balances and all LP shares already at the pair, so unrelated donations can alter results.

Swaps require a path of at least two tokens, active pairs and sufficient reserves. Native input paths start with WMON and native output paths end with WMON. Set intentional amountOutMin/amountInMax and deadline (Unix seconds, inclusive); all quantities use token base units. Exact-input outputs floor and exact-output inputs round up per hop; library applies 997/1000 input multiplier (0.3% pair fee). Fees, price movement and price impact remain economic risks, not guarantees.

Liquidity uses current reserve ratio and expiry. On addLiquidity, only the reduced/optimal side is checked against its minimum; the full desired side is not independently minimum-checked. Empty pools use both desired amounts directly without enforcing either minimum. There is no minimum-LP-share parameter. Initial pair mint permanently locks 1000 units; floor rounding and feeTo protocol LP minting affect shares/payout. removeLiquidity checks both gross pair-returned amounts, not net receipts after token taxes.

Ordinary amount-preserving paths and four non-permit supporting-fee variants are admitted. Supporting token-output swaps check recipient balance delta. Supporting token-to-native swaps unwrap the entire router WMON balance; supporting native liquidity removal forwards the entire router token balance. Never prefund router. Removal minima do not guarantee net post-tax receipt. Rebasing, malicious, restricted and taxed tokens can still fail. All permit/signature paths remain excluded.

Withdraw/redeem burn owner shares, require preexisting allowance when effective caller differs from owner, and send assets to receiver. This catalog creates no owner/operator allowance. Lending, token, EVC, Permit2, linked-library and mutable strategy risks remain; dependencies are not independently runtime-attested here.
